verdicts.change: Make each refusal name the specific failed check (bad refrigerant code, non-numeric input, suction at or above discharge, below vacuum, or negative superheat) instead of one generic 'readings impossible, re-read gauges' message, which wrongly blames the gauges when the refrigerant code is the problem.

Have superheatF and subcoolingF return the readingCheck reason code with the refusal, so a logged refusal says which rule fired (for example negative superheat vs. bad refrigerant code) rather than one blanket message.
Make each refusal name the one input that failed (e.g. 'refrigerant code 99 is not 0-6') instead of repeating the full list of limits for every case.
